Latest released updates
1.1.0 — Add ChatGPT helper on entity pages (2026-07-09)
Added an always visible Ask ChatGPT action on entity pages that opens a prefilled prompt for the selected entity, so users can continue the conversation in one click.

1.0.0 — Major Atlas refresh flow and home updates (2026-07-09)
Added event-driven Atlas refresh from private after real feed deltas, and continued polishing major public-facing surfaces, including Home cover behavior and versioned release visibility.

0.6.1 — Sharper entity search (2026-07-09)
Added ranked, accent-insensitive entity suggestions, regional search indexes and cleaner directory states for filtered results.

0.6.0 — Regional radar launch (2026-07-09)
Added isolated US and Spain radar routes, localized product pages, a radar switcher, scheduled refresh from private feeds and stricter public entity quality checks.

0.5.1 — Atlas domain polish (2026-07-07)
Cleaned up the public Atlas domain, legacy links, error pages and entity anchor behavior.

0.5.0 — Cleaner public surfaces (2026-07-07)
Simplified the home search, tightened featured entity selection and brought the What's new page in line with the white interior layout used by About and directory pages.

0.4.0 — Immersive entity cover (2026-07-06)
Reworked the home and entity template around a full-screen news image cover, overlay navigation and a continuous timeline that starts inside the image.

0.3.0 — Validated event model (2026-07-06)
Aligned the project with the entity-first knowledge engine spec: validated events, entity JSON as source of truth and story pages kept out of the public portal.
